scope: N4 is homogeneous quadratic in the same actual scaled value vector. Expanding b0*Ntilde-z1*(ad+M*b0*s)-b0*z2*(M*s²-D) exactly gives the already computed Bbar4. Multiplying the existing Phi*L identity returns Phi Bbar4 in the original N4,Edelta,E2 ideal without D or b0 inverses or third moment. Current W weight units only, no extrapolation to general h=k.
